senses.gloss: lūna-lipi, a kind of script: LV 〔126.1〕 (between Cīna- and Hūna-l˚). Omitted in one ms., one corrects to dūna-; Tib. phu na; not in the Mv parallel list 〔i.135〕. Kirfel, Kosm., records, as names of peoples, Lūta (84), and Līna (88).
[lūnāti, prob. uncorrected misprint for Skt. lunāti: LV 〔286.4〕 (prose). No v.l. in Lefm., yet Calc. reads lu˚; not noted in Weller.]
